# Data handling and privacy

What the product stores, where, and what it can contain. Facts for counsel; not a privacy notice.

| Data | Stored in | Keyed by | May contain user text | Contents | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Operator credential | Deployment environment variables | not applicable | No | Operator username and a bcrypt hash or plain password. | Requires operational controls |
| Operator session cookie | Browser cookie | user id in the token | No | User id, username, login time and a signature. No personal data beyond the operator username. | Implemented and verified |
| Anonymous demo cookie | Browser cookie | random demo id | No | A random demo identity, login time and a signature. No personal data. | Implemented and verified |
| Projects and cost lines | SQLite database | user_id (sub-lines through project_id) | Yes | Project code and name, inputs and assumptions, governance state and the last run summary. | Requires operational controls |
| Scenarios and workspace state | SQLite database | user_id | Yes | Scenario inputs, overrides and the working copy. | Requires operational controls |
| Run records and exports | SQLite database | user_id | Yes | Inputs and KPI snapshots per run, and export metadata (names, lineage). Generated workbook files, when written, live on the host file system. | Requires operational controls |
| Run history (immutable) | SQLite database | user_id | Yes | One immutable row per successful run: full financial statements, debt, tax, distribution and sponsor schedules, integrity evidence. | Requires operational controls |
| Database backups | Files on the host (default under the data directory) | whole database | Yes | A full copy of every table above. | Requires operational controls |
| Application and access logs | Standard output, then host log storage | none | No | Method, path, status and request id. No cookies, bodies or client addresses. | Requires operational controls |
| Rate-limit counters | Process memory | client address or demo id | No | Failed-login counts and demo operation counts. | Implemented and verified |
| Imported model files | Not stored | not applicable | Yes | Processed in memory to prefill a project; the upload is not written to disk. | Implemented and verified |

---
Reviewed 2026-10-10. This pack covers the FINCO Model product: modelling, persistence, authentication, run evidence and release readiness. Radar, Yield and token or wallet features have their own data and controls and are not assessed here. This document describes the product. It is not a legal document, an audit opinion or a certification.
